newsitem.title: THAILAND: Value of Jan-Aug Thai vehicle, parts exports down.
newsitem.headline: Value of Jan-Aug Thai vehicle, parts exports down.

text.p: The value of Thai exports of assembled vehicles and parts fell 13.2 percent in the first eight months to 6.19 billion baht from 7.13 billion in the same period last year, an industry group said on Thursday.

The export value of cars and car parts during January-August slipped 14.82 percent to 1.91 billion baht compared with 2.25 billion baht in the same period a year ago, the Thai Automobile Industry Association in a statement.
The value of motorcycles and motorcycle parts in the period was down 12.46 percent to 4.27 billion baht against 4.88 billion over the first eight months of 1995, the association said.
The total number of passenger cars and commercial vehicles assembled in Thailand during January-August period was up 6.95 percent to 361,773 against 338,227 in the same period a year ago, it said.
